messages:
Maya (CSM): Heads-up: ACME trial tenant is consistently doing streaming chats ~10 r/s with long sessions. Renewal is sensitive to latency — can we put together a short customer-facing kickoff + an internal handshake runbook to catch renewal risk early?

Jordan (CS Ops): Yes — thinking a 'streamflow handshake' pattern for stream-first tenants: lightweight prefill + tenant soft quotas + a renewal-risk telemetry tag. I'll sketch steps.

Ethan (Solutions): Love that. We should include a minimal client snippet for the onboarding guide: `prefill:true, prefill_count:3, stream:true, per_tenant_burst:20` so PSDs can paste it.

Priya (SRE): Add SLOs and fallback logic. If stream p95 > 300ms for 60s -> autoscale canary + fallback to model-variant `v1-small`. Also set an alert to avoid noisy blips. @oncall-bot can you create an alert?

oncall-bot: Alert created: `infra-alerts` stream_p95_high for tenant ACME — threshold 300ms over 60s. Incident channel: #infra-alerts.

Jordan (CS Ops): Draft internal runbook (short):
1) Confirm client prefill is enabled and prefill_count >= 2
2) Enable tenant cache-warming on first-session open
3) Sample and store first-10 responses with redaction for quality evals
4) If >2 minutes of degraded p95 in 24h, set CRM tag `stream_risk=medium/high` and escalate

Maya (CSM): We also need a one-paragraph, non-technical customer note explaining prefill/quota behavior for kickoff. ACME wants simple language.

Ethan (Solutions): Draft customer-facing text: "To keep latency low during live sessions well briefly pre-warm your session to reduce cold starts. You may see short quota bursts while we stabilize the session. Well monitor performance and reach out if we detect any degradation."

Maya (CSM): :thumbsup: Add a privacy line: "We do not store user content beyond brief telemetry samples; samples are PII-redacted before review."

Priya (SRE): SRE handoff checklist (what CS sends to SRE): tenant_id, sample_session_ids (<=3), first_observed_latency, any 429/5xx counts, streaming vs batch flag. Keep the note under 5 bullets for quick triage.

Jordan (CS Ops): Also: CRM integration — add a custom field `stream_risk` (low/med/high). Attach the recent 10 sampling metrics and the short action_taken note. This helps renewal and AMs.

Maya (CSM): I'll own sending the customer email and the first-touch runbook. Can someone paste the minimal prefill snippet for the onboarding doc?

Ethan (Solutions): Minimal snippet for onboarding guide:
```
// client init example
client.init({
  prefill: true,
  prefillSamples: 3,
  stream: true,
  retryPolicy: 'jittered-exponential'
});
```

Jordan (CS Ops): Add a 48h post-launch checklist: monitor p95 latency, error rate, memory pressure on the tenant pool, and perform a customer touch at ~24h. If any metric exceeds threshold, open an eng-bridge and schedule a 30m sync.

Maya (CSM): Great — I'll collate this into a one-pager and attach it to the kickoff email. Uploading runbook to Drive and will drop the link here once available.

oncall-bot: Runbook created in Drive: https://drive.company/internal/runbooks/streamflow-handshake-ACME (private)
